title: Before you set off
goal: Say what happens before something with -mAzdAn öň, and tell it apart from -Andan soň.

intro.text: **Before** is `-mAzdAn` and *öň*: *ýat-* → *ýatmazdan öň*, before going to bed; *gel-* → *gelmezden öň*. It looks negative, but it isn't: *Ýatmazdan öň kitap okaýaryn* (I read before going to bed). No *e* → *ä* here: *işlemezden öň*.

vocab.en: to say goodbye; to take leave

exercises.question: How do you say **before going to bed**?
exercises.explain: *ýat-* + *-mazdan* + *öň*. It looks negative, but it means **before**.
*gelmek* has a front vowel: *-mezden*, and no *ä*.

exercises.en: We cleaned the house before the guests came.

accept: mezden

exercises.explain: *gel-* + *-mezden* + *öň*: before (they) came. The guests are its subject, *biz* the subject of *arassaladyk*.

accept: I read before going to bed.

reject.why: *Çykandan soň* is **after** you set off. **Before**: *çykmazdan öň*.

reject.answer: Ýola çykmandan öň, maňa jaň et.

exercises.explain: *Ýola çykmazdan öň* (before setting off) first, then the request: *maňa jaň et*.

exercises.question: *Nahar iýmezden öň elimi ýuwdum.* When did I wash my hands?

why.2: It looks negative, but I did eat, afterwards: `-mAzdAn öň` means **before**.

exercises.title: Mara syýahat
exercises.passage:
Geçen hepde Aýna Mara gitdi. Ýola çykmazdan öň, ol sumkasyny taýýarlady we ejesi bilen hoşlaşdy. Kakasy ony wokzala çenli ugratdy. Otly ugramazdan öň, Aýna kakasyna Mara ýetenden soň jaň etjekdigini aýtdy.

Ýolda ol kitap okady, soňra uklady. Mara ýetenden soň, derrew kakasyna jaň etdi. Agşam ýatmazdan öň, ol Gadymy Merw barada okady.

glossary.en: Ancient Merv, the ruined city near Mary

exercises.translation: Last week Aýna went to Mary. Before setting off, she got her bag ready and said goodbye to her mother. Her father saw her off at the station. Before the train left, Aýna told her father she would call him after she reached Mary. On the way she read a book, then she slept. After reaching Mary, she called her father at once. In the evening, before going to bed, she read about Ancient Merv.

questions.q: Who saw Aýna off at the station?
When did she say she would call?
questions.explain: *Mara ýetenden soň jaň etjekdigini aýtdy*: after she reached Mary.

questions.q: What did she do before going to bed?
questions.explain: *Agşam ýatmazdan öň, ol Gadymy Merw barada okady.*
